correctness.rationale: Direct normalized-area harmonic Bergman monomial projections yield coefficient (u-v)r_{u+v}/(v+1), and no remaining analytic/constant components. Column normalization gives skew Hankel matrix. Distinct pole exponential-polynomial features and finite support are linearly independent; full-column-rank factorization makes the total rank additive. An explicit anti-diagonal coefficient calculation and odd-dimensional skew upper bound establish the exact pole and polynomial ranks. The standalone Python 3 checker passed nine exact rank cases and 729 direct projection coefficient assertions; these are supplementary to the proof.
